global_rules: Do not overwrite canonical API JSONs during normal generation; copy to a runtime/sandbox file and patch the copy.

Keep generated images outside this canonical workflow pack.
Do not claim quality or production readiness without artifact/contact-sheet/Ren'Py QA.
When user performs visual QA, report output paths and seeds without inventing visual judgments.

fixed_defaults_observed.owner_taste_note: Cinematic testing should not be read as a requirement to mix many presets into every batch. The practical rule is that the tested tag blocks responded well and are relatively safe candidate sets when the script beat matches. Keep close/upper_body as neutral default; use reaching/POV-involvement and from_above shock candidates only when beat-matched; avoid wide_shot/full_body defaults.
fixed_defaults_observed.cinematic_candidate_rule: Use the cinematic candidate blocks as reusable beat-matched tag sets, not as mandatory batch composition. Keep generated outputs QA-gated for face, identity, hands, outfit, background, and RenPy textbox/safe-area fit.

fixed_defaults_observed.pipeline_rule: Production route is source frame/ornament generation plus deterministic procedural cleanup variants V08-V10 when the source center contains medallions/ghosting; Korean overlay/contrast previews are diagnostics, not the design objective.
fixed_defaults_observed.best_current_variant_pattern: Do not select by text fit alone. 2026-06-04 final cleanplate: V08_production_solid_cleanplate_balanced, V09_production_solid_cleanplate_wide, and V10_production_deep_red_cleanplate resolve visible center ghosting with fully opaque textless plates; V08 is the current balanced review candidate, V09 is widest/readability-safe, V10 is the redder alternate.

fixed_defaults_observed.recommended_bgm_duration: 20-30s source candidates for QA; longer only after direction approval and loop/edit planning
fixed_defaults_observed.recommended_sfx_duration: 1.5-2.5s for one-shots; 3-8s for longer foley/magic/ambience-like effects
fixed_defaults_observed.prompt_route: direct prompt first; TextGenerate branch is optional A/B only
fixed_defaults_observed.negative_prompt_default: blank by role contract unless a specific recurrent failure must be suppressed
fixed_defaults_observed.bgm_prompt_shape: instrumentation + musical form/rhythm + mood + short role
fixed_defaults_observed.sfx_prompt_shape: short positive-only natural-language cue + one/two material or timbre colors
fixed_defaults_observed.role_routing: asset_type bgm -> audio_bgm role, asset_type sfx -> audio_sfx role; both execute this same workflow JSON
